question.prompt: Without changing the value of the algebraic fraction, multiply both the numerator and denominator of \((0.2x+0.5)/(0.3x-0.1)\) by 10 to obtain \((ax+5)/(bx-1)\). What is \(a+b\)?

solutions.explanation: Multiplying the numerator \(0.2x+0.5\) by 10 gives \(2x+5\), and multiplying the denominator \(0.3x-0.1\) by 10 gives \(3x-1\). Thus, \(a=2\), \(b=3\), and \(a+b=5\).
solutions.title: Multiply every term by 10
